tests.title: "AC5: an anonymous visitor to /customers and /customers/<id> is redirected to /login"
"AC1: /customers renders the populated list; search narrows it; no-results state appears"
"AC1 search by org_nr: the company is findable by its org number"
"AC1 filter by type: filtering to Privatperson hides the company customer"
"P0: the /customers LIST never contains a personnummer value"
"P0/AC2: the private customer DETAIL shows the personnummer MASKED (not clear-text by default)"
"AC4: creating a customer via the dialog persists and appears in the list"
"AC3: a validation failure shows a field-associated error + summary and preserves input"
"AC3: opening a dialog moves focus IN; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger"
"AC6: the shell shows EXACTLY the active manifest nav and NONE of the deferred labels"
"AC2: the detail hub shows honest 'not yet built' areas and NO deferred-module section"
"AC2: a non-existent / other-tenant customer id renders a GENERIC not-found (no leakage)"
"B01 E35-3-T-AC1/AC2 loaded/no-match: independent selection, sort and reset preserve identity"
"B02 E35-3-T-validation/confirmed AC3: summary links focus the actual invalid field and retain unsent input"
"B03 E35-3-T-error-retry AC3/AC7: archive cancel and confirm retain customer identity and soft archive"
"B03 R3 offline archive: zero dispatch and no hint until one explicit confirmed retry after reconnect"
"B03 R1 archive: pending edit exclusion and requested Back history survive one real archive"
"B03 R1 archive: lost real response blocks replay through reopen and remount"
"B03 R1 archive: unavailable storage prevents dispatch and preserves the whole snapshot"
"B05 R1 offline before dispatch retains input without a hint; explicit reconnect saves once"
"B04 E35-3-T-submitting/confirmed AC3/AC5: one real attempt and busy Escape/close protection"
`B05 E35-3-T-connection-required/unknown AC6: ${mode} retains unconfirmed input and blocks replay after remount`
"B06 E35-3-T-stale/late-result/confirmed AC6/AC7: two real editors preserve conflict draft until explicit fresh review"
`B07 E35-3-T-dirty-navigation/focus-dialog AC5: ${traversal} is cancelled before URL/history commit`
"B06 E35-3-T-loading/late-result AC2/AC5: delayed A read cannot replace the newer B selection"
"B07 E35-3-T-focus-dialog/dirty-navigation AC5: focus wraps and cancelling dirty Escape retains the draft"
"B05 E35-3-T-unknown AC6: unavailable safety storage fails closed before dispatch"
"B05 E35-3-T-unknown AC6: corrupt unresolved hint cannot enable a fresh customer command"
"B08 E35-3-T-AC4: connected 360×640 targets, labeled overflow and visible actions/errors"
"B09 E35-3-T-empty/denied/revoked AC6: successful empty differs from foreign denial and live revocation"
"B10 E35-3-T-AC5/AC7 inherited contracts: facility/contact labels, summary, cancel and focus remain usable"
"CUSTOMER_TYPE_LABELS maps exactly the four owner-approved types to Swedish badges"
"isCustomerType accepts the four types and rejects anything else"
"customerTypeLabel falls back to the raw string for an unknown type (never throws)"
"toCustomerListItem maps a projection row WITHOUT any personnummer slot (private-data posture)"
"toCustomerListItem: a private customer surfaces NO identifier in the list (org_nr is null)"
"matchesQuery: empty/whitespace query matches everything"
"matchesQuery searches display_name / org_nr / email / phone / city, case-insensitively"
"maskPersonnummer masks all but the last 4 chars; null/short are safe"
"findDuplicateLikeNames: case-insensitive exact display_name match over ACTIVE customers only"
"toCustomerListItem: undefined optional columns collapse to null (no undefined leaks into the view-model)"
"toCustomerListItem: an unknown customer_type still renders (raw-string label fallback, never throws)"
"matchesQuery: a query that ONLY matches the identifier still matches (org_nr is searchable)"
"matchesQuery: null fields are skipped, never coerced to the string 'null'"
"matchesQuery: the query itself is trimmed before matching"
"matchesQuery: a partial substring within a field matches"
"maskPersonnummer: an exactly-4-char value is fully masked (boundary: <= 4 → all bullets)"
"maskPersonnummer: surrounding whitespace is trimmed before the last-4 reveal"
"maskPersonnummer: a whitespace-only value masks to a single bullet — never the raw spaces (no leak)"
"findDuplicateLikeNames: returns ALL active matches, and a substring near-miss does NOT match (exact only)"
"findDuplicateLikeNames: a whitespace-only candidate matches nothing"
"findDuplicateLikeNames: an empty existing list yields no matches"
"35.3 E35-3-T-unknown: a verified payload-free hint blocks replay through remount until its owner finishes"
"35.3 E35-3-T-unknown: corrupt, missing-owned and inaccessible hint cannot clear an unresolved attempt"
"35.3 E35-3-T-unknown: silent storage write or delete failure never admits an unverified transition"
